description.subtitle: G-Form football shinplates with fastening meshes - white
description.intro: G-Form Pro-S Blade offers a perfect combination of safety, lightness and comfort. Designed to suit your game, these shinmills are ideal for players looking for performance without distractions.
key_benefits: Anatomical adjustment: It fits perfectly to the leg to avoid unnecessary movements.
Maximum freedom: Without sacrificing protection, it allows a fluid and fast play.
Comodidad duradera: Materiales ligeros y transpirables para sesiones intensas.
Advanced protection: Absorbs impacts without compromising mobility.
